failures.question: Bサイト元素ごとの平均形成エネルギーを出して。
failures.gen_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.band_gap
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    c.site_label = 'B-site'

LIMIT 10000;
failures.gold_sql:
SELECT c.element AS b_site_element,
       AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_formation_energy
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'B-site'
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY avg_formation_energy ASC
LIMIT 10000;

failures.question: Ni基超合金のγ'相候補として有望な、安定または準安定なL1₂型化合物を抽出して。
failures.gen_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.element = 'Ni'
  AND c.atomic_fraction >= 0.5
  AND (ps.is_stable = TRUE OR ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.1)
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;
failures.gold_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT m.entry_id, m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

failures.question: 安定なL1₂化合物をAサイト元素でグループ化し、各グループの平均形成エネルギーを出して。
failures.gen_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, s.prototype, s.lattice_a, s.space_group, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.band_gap
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
    AND c.site_label = 'A-site'

LIMIT 10000;
failures.gold_sql:
SELECT c.element AS a_site_element,
       AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_eform,
       COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY avg_eform ASC
LIMIT 10000;

failures.question: 格子定数3.55Å付近でバルクモジュラスの高いL1₂化合物を探して。
failures.gen_sql:
SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.55) <= 0.05
ORDER BY cp.value DESC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.55) ASC
LIMIT 10000;
failures.gold_sql:
SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.55) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.55) <= 0.1
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

failures.question: Al系L1₂化合物のうち安定なものとそうでないものの数を出して。
failures.gen_sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) AS stable_al_l12_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = FALSE) AS unstable_al_l12_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Al'
  )
LIMIT 10000;
failures.gold_sql:
SELECT
  CASE WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001 THEN 'stable' ELSE 'not_stable' END AS stability,
  COUNT(*) AS count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Al'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
GROUP BY CASE WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001 THEN 'stable' ELSE 'not_stable' END
ORDER BY stability
LIMIT 10000;

failures.question: Fe含有L1₂化合物の安定性と弾性特性を同時に表示して。
failures.gen_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    m.formula,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.is_stable,
    COALESCE(cp.tensor_component, cp.property_name) AS elastic_component,
    cp.value
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE c.element = 'Fe'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND (
      cp.property_name IN ('C11', 'C12', 'C44')
      OR cp.tensor_component IN ('C11', 'C12', 'C44')
  )
ORDER BY m.formula, elastic_component
LIMIT 10000;
failures.gold_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable,
       cp.property_name, cp.value
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE c.element = 'Fe'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY m.formula, cp.property_name
LIMIT 10000;

failures.question: L1₂型金属間化合物において、相安定性、格子ミスマッチ、弾性特性を同時に考慮した析出強化相候補を抽出して。
failures.gen_sql:
SELECT
    m.formula,
    ps.is_stable,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    s.lattice_a,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
    cp_c11.value AS C11,
    cp_c12.value AS C12,
    cp_c44.value AS C44
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c11 ON cp_c11.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    AND cp_c11.tensor_component = 'C11'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c12 ON cp_c12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    AND cp_c12.tensor_component = 'C12'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c44 ON cp_c44.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    AND cp_c44.tensor_component = 'C44'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.number_of_elements >= 2
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY
    ps.energy_above_hull ASC,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC,
    cp_c44.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;
failures.gold_sql:
SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
       cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_mismatch
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
  AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

failures.question: γ'相候補のランキングを安定性・格子整合性・バルクモジュラスの重み付きスコアで出して。
failures.gen_sql:
SELECT
    m.formula,
    ps.is_stable,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    s.lattice_a,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
    cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
    (
        0.5 * (1.0 / (1.0 + GREATEST(ps.energy_above_hull, 0.0))) +
        0.3 * (1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57))) +
        0.2 * (cp.value / 300.0)
    ) AS weighted_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY weighted_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;
failures.gold_sql:
SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.energy_above_hull,
       cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus,
       (1.0 - ps.energy_above_hull / 0.05) * 0.4
       + (1.0 - ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) / 0.3) * 0.3
       + (cp_bm.value / 300.0) * 0.3 AS weighted_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
  AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY weighted_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

failures.question: 高温安定性の観点で有望なL1₂型化合物を形成エネルギーの深さで評価して上位を出して。

SELECT DISTINCT

failures.question: Ni基超合金のγ'相代替候補として、Ni-Al系以外で安定なL1₂化合物を格子整合性で評価して。
failures.gen_sql:
SELECT
  m.formula,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND m.chemical_system NOT IN ('Al-Ni', 'Ni-Al')
ORDER BY lattice_diff ASC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;
failures.gold_sql:
SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
       ps.energy_above_hull, cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS mismatch,
       (1.0 - LEAST(ps.energy_above_hull, 0.05) / 0.05) * 0.30
       + (1.0 - LEAST(ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57), 0.3) / 0.3) * 0.25
       + (LEAST(cp_bm.value, 300) / 300.0) * 0.25
       + (CASE WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom < -0.3 THEN 0.20 ELSE 0.10 END) AS design_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
  AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY design_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

failures.question: L1₂化合物のうちNi3Alより安定でバルクモジュラスが高い候補を出して。
failures.gen_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
       m.formula,
       ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       ps.is_stable,
       s.lattice_a,
       cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
  AND cp.value IS NOT NULL
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < (
      SELECT ps_ref.formation_energy_per_atom
      FROM material_entry m_ref
      JOIN phase_stability ps_ref ON ps_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      JOIN structure s_ref ON s_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      WHERE (m_ref.formula = 'Ni3Al' OR m_ref.reduced_formula = 'Ni3Al')
        AND (s_ref.prototype = 'L12' OR s_ref.strukturbericht = 'L12')
        AND ps_ref.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
      ORDER BY ps_ref.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
      LIMIT 1
  )
  AND cp.value > (
      SELECT cp_ref.value
      FROM material_entry m_ref2
      JOIN structure s_ref2 ON s_ref2.entry_id = m_ref2.entry_id
      JOIN calculation calc_ref ON calc_ref.entry_id = m_ref2.entry_id
      JOIN calculated_property cp_ref ON cp_ref.calculation_id = calc_ref.calculation_id
      WHERE (m_ref2.formula = 'Ni3Al' OR m_ref2.reduced_formula = 'Ni3Al')
        AND (s_ref2.prototype = 'L12' OR s_ref2.strukturbericht = 'L12')
        AND cp_ref.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
        AND cp_ref.value IS NOT NULL
      ORDER BY cp_ref.value DESC
      LIMIT 1
  )
ORDER BY cp.value DESC, ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;
failures.gold_sql:
SELECT m.formula,
       s.lattice_a,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus,
       cp_sm.value AS shear_modulus,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS mismatch
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
JOIN calculated_property cp_sm ON cp_sm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_sm.property_name = 'shear_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, cp_bm.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;
